proposals: The Reserve Bank of India should release a provisional full-year services trade figure within the same quarter that the Commerce Ministry publishes full-year goods trade, so that the overall balance for FY2025-26 does not have to wait a year while the goods deficit is already known.

MoSPI should refresh the forex-reserves series in its data connector from the RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement at least monthly and show its last-updated date, so that users do not unknowingly cite a series frozen at June 2025 as current reserves.

The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade should publish a single dated PLI outlay figure with a note reconciling the ₹1.97 lakh crore and ₹1.91 lakh crore totals that PIB releases cite, so that the headline commitment is not quoted two ways.

NITI Aayog should publish, for each PLI sector, an annual table of incentives disbursed alongside imports and exports of the covered HS chapters and their top source countries, so that whether five years of incentives have bent the import curve can be checked against the scheme’s own money.
